clue.text: Show fanatical holy man before judge

parts.note: a demon is a fanatic, someone fiendishly keen, as in a demon for work
ST is the usual abbreviation for saint
to rate is to judge or assess

explanation.surface: A zealous cleric performs ahead of a court official.
explanation.definitionFit: To show something is to display or prove it, a plain synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Quits purchasing gutless League teams

indicators.note: purchasing means taking hold of, so the quits word wraps round the other piece

parts.note: being quits means being even, so EVENS

indicators.note: gutless says the word League loses its insides, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A league buys out its feeble sides to settle the score.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quits' reads as a verb meaning leaves; here it is the adjective, as in being square with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket and football sides have eleven players, so an eleven is a team.

clue.text: Phobia of old boy going to meeting

parts.note: OB is the standard abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
a session is a meeting of a group or court

explanation.surface: A former pupil is terrified of attending a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A phobia is an irrational fixation of fear, loosely an obsessive dread.

clue.text: Small domestic animals brought up stairs

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up says the pieces are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes
pets are animals kept in the home

explanation.surface: Little household creatures are carried up the staircase.
explanation.definitionFit: Steps are the treads of a staircase, a near synonym in the plural.

clue.text: Disease caught off insects

indicators.note: off says the caught letter is removed from the insects

parts.note: crickets are chirping insects
C is the cricket scoring abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An illness picked up from bugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Caught' looks like catching a disease, but it is the letter C taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: Rickets is a bone-softening illness caused by vitamin D deficiency.

clue.text: In that place, catching a tragedy's opening?

definitions.text: In that place, catching a tragedy's opening?

indicators.note: catching means holding inside, so the place word wraps round the rest

parts.note: there means in that place

indicators.note: a word's opening is its first letter

explanation.surface: Somewhere you might see the start of a tragedy.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes a playhouse, where a tragedy has its opening night.
explanation.definitionFit: A playhouse is where a tragedy would open, so the whole clue paints the venue.

clue.text: Queen record left brilliant players time for 'Substitute'

parts.note: R stands for Regina, Latin for queen
an EP is an extended-play record
ace means brilliant, excellent
men are players in a team, as chess pieces or squad members
T is the abbreviation for time in physics

explanation.surface: A rock band's record has the great performers out and a time slot for a song called Substitute.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen looks like the rock band; here it is just R.
explanation.definitionFit: A substitute is a stand-in, someone or something put in place of another.

clue.text: Featuring old lino, pub's oddly unpleasant

indicators.note: oddly says take the first, third, fifth letters and so on of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A pub with old lino is not a nice place.
explanation.definitionFit: Odious means hateful or repulsive, a strong form of disagreeable.

clue.text: Attend lessons, some boring

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Going to classes, some of which are tedious.
explanation.definitionFit: Something endless goes on and on, so it becomes tedious and wearisome.

clue.text: Outdo former wife with children, say

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse

indicators.note: say signals that the word for children is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: seed is an old word for offspring or descendants

explanation.surface: A divorced woman with kids tries to beat her rival.
explanation.definitionFit: To exceed is to go beyond or surpass, a synonym of outdo.

clue.text: Make one's own series on lap dancing

indicators.note: dancing letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: Customising a run of lap-dance performances.
explanation.definitionFit: To tailor an item so it reflects its owner, so it becomes one's own.

clue.text: Ferocious female defending her pride?

parts.note: pride reads like self-respect, but a pride is a group of lions, which the female big cat guards

explanation.surface: A fierce woman protecting her self-respect.
explanation.definitionFit: A she-lion lives in and protects a pride, the name for a lion group.

clue.text: Spirit of honour about to end

indicators.note: to end says the about letters are shifted to the end of the honour word

parts.note: to respect someone is to honour them
RE means about, concerning

explanation.surface: The spirit of honour is about to die out.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectre is a ghost, a spirit that haunts.

clue.text: Direction in musical for groups of actors

indicators.note: in puts the direction letter inside the musical's name

parts.note: Cats is the Lloyd Webber musical
S stands for south, a compass direction

explanation.surface: Stage instructions in a show for the companies of performers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cast is the set of actors in a production; plural for several groups.

clue.text: Fakes the compiler's blog contributors

parts.note: the setter speaking of themselves gives I'M, I am
people who write posts on a blog are posters

explanation.surface: The setter's online commenters are frauds.
explanation.definitionFit: Impostors (also spelt this way) pretend to be someone else, so they are frauds.

clue.text: De Niro part almost recast for 'Doom'

indicators.note: recast means cast again in a new shape, so the letters are rearranged
almost says the last letter of the word part is dropped

explanation.surface: A Robert De Niro role nearly given to someone else for a film called Doom.
explanation.walkthrough: Recast plays on film casting; it rearranges DENIRO plus PAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To doom is to fix a fate in advance, the sense of decree beforehand.

clue.text: Fluid mechanics causing accident

indicators.note: fluid means flowing and changeable, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fluid mechanics, the branch of physics, leads to a mishap.
explanation.walkthrough: Fluid mechanics is a real science, so 'Fluid' hides as an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A mischance is bad luck, an unlucky mishap.

clue.text: Start to sew more extensive piece of embroidery

indicators.note: start to means the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: ampler is the comparative of ample, more extensive

explanation.surface: Begin stitching a bigger needlework project.
explanation.definitionFit: A sampler is a cloth showing embroidery stitches, often alphabets and mottos.

clue.text: Consort with hard American group

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
a band is a musical group

explanation.surface: Hanging around with a tough US pop group.
explanation.definitionFit: A consort is a spouse, the partner of a monarch for instance.

clue.text: Pile of stones roughly hard, not round

parts.note: CA is circa, roughly

indicators.note: not says the round letter is taken away

parts.note: iron is a byword for hard, as in iron will
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Stones heaped up loosely, hard and angular.
explanation.definitionFit: A cairn is a mound of stones marking a summit or grave.

clue.text: Satisfaction from varying in bed

indicators.note: in says the shuffled letters go inside the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: varying means changing, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Contentment comes from switching positions in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' reads like a link joining definition to wordplay, but it is the word being rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfort is ease and contentment, a kind of satisfaction.

clue.text: Raised in brood, nightjar's covered

indicators.note: Raised says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A nightjar's young were reared under shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft gave no word for the hiding; 'in' signals it, and 'Raised' turns ROODNI upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something indoor is under a roof, so it is covered or sheltered.

clue.text: Fantasise mentally, embracing return of vengeance

indicators.note: return of says the enclosed letters are read backwards
embracing means holding within, so the letters lie inside the words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Daydreaming in the mind about getting revenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embracing' picks SISEMEN out of the opening words; 'return of' turns them round.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis is retribution, named after the Greek goddess of retribution.

clue.text: Second squad showing enthusiasm

parts.note: a squad is a team

explanation.surface: The reserve side shows energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam is energy or drive, as in full steam ahead.

clue.text: Do maiden over in length of material?

definitions.text: Do maiden over in length of material?

indicators.note: in puts the maiden letter and turned word inside the reel

parts.note: a reel holds a length of thread or film
M is the cricket abbreviation for maiden, an over with no runs

indicators.note: over says the word Do is turned round

parts.note: do taken as written

explanation.surface: In cricket, bowling a scoreless over again, or recutting cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden over is a cricket over with no runs; both cricket words split up. The whole clue also suggests remaking a dress from a length of fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: To redo something in a new form is to reshape or rebuild it.

clue.text: Clubs set out for Open

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games
to set out is to leave, depart

explanation.surface: Golfers' clubs packed for the Open championship.
explanation.walkthrough: The Open is a golf tournament, which 'Clubs' supports, but here it is the verb to split.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleave is to split apart, so to open with a blade.

clue.text: After a second awake, practically lustful

indicators.note: after puts the awake word behind the first pieces

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second

indicators.note: practically means nearly all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: rouse means to wake or be awake

explanation.surface: Within a moment of waking, nearly full of desire.
explanation.definitionFit: Amorous means full of sexual desire or love.

clue.text: Remained top, affected to be superior

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Stayed in first place, pretending to be better.
explanation.definitionFit: To predominate is to prevail, to be greater in power or number.
